I’m ready to deduce the structure, but I need experimental information about the sample. Could you please provide any of the following data?

- ¹H NMR (chemical‑shift values, multiplicities, integration)  
- ¹³C NMR (chemical‑shift values)  
- IR spectrum (key absorption bands)  
- Mass‑spectrometry (molecular‑ion m/z and notable fragments)  
- A brief description of the compound (physical state, odor, known functional groups, etc.)

With that information I can determine the correct SMILES string.
